name: Read a member's current savings balance
description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console, looks up a member by their member ID, and returns the member's name and the current balance of their savings account.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: The member's identifier, as printed on their statement.

outputs.name: member_name
outputs.description: Name on the member record for member 100234

outputs.name: savings_account_number
outputs.description: Account number of the account with type Savings

outputs.name: savings_current_balance
outputs.description: Current balance of the Savings account SAV-100234-01

strategies.rationale: This control is identified by the adjacent text 'Ballard' in the surrounding layout, which is how an operator reads the form. Used because the control may lose its name; it survives restyling and renaming of the underlying control, and breaks only if the form is restructured.

checkpoint.description: the application shows that the goal was reached: Sign on to the servicing console, look up member 100234, open their record, and read back the member's name and the current balance of their savings account.

business_outcomes.description: No member exists with the supplied ID. A legitimate answer the caller needs in order to act, not a failure of the automation.

detect.description: the search screen reports no matching record

business_outcomes.description: The supplied operator credentials were rejected by the console.

detect.description: the sign-on screen reports a failed sign-on

recovery.name: dismiss_maintenance_notice
recovery.description: The console interposes a maintenance notice at unpredictable points. It carries nothing the caller needs and is cleared by its own Continue button.

target.description: the Continue button on the notice

strategies.rationale: The notice renders a single submit control labelled Continue.
strategies.name: Continue

recovery.name: reauthenticate_expired_session
recovery.description: Sessions expire on inactivity. This capability only reads, so replaying it from the start changes nothing -- which is what makes re-authentication safe here and would not make it safe in a flow that writes.

detect.description: the console reports the session has expired

failure_signals.description: The console raised an unhandled application error. Nothing the automation did caused it and nothing it can do will clear it.

detect.description: the console is showing an application error page

provenance.notes: Synthesised from a single successful discovery run. It records the path that worked and nothing else: business outcomes, recovery rules and failure signals describe what happens when things go otherwise and cannot be observed on a run that went right. They are added at review, which is what the draft state is for. Success phrases ['Member Detail - 100234'] were discarded because they contain values the caller supplies, so they describe this invocation rather than the screen. Reviewed by hand: business outcomes, recovery rules and failure signals added, and the capability approved for unattended replay.
